index.description.001: E-Ink Assistant tunes contrast, shadow detail, and color on e-ink displays for macOS and Windows.
index.text.002: E-Ink Assistant for macOS and Windows
index.text.012:
Tune your e‑ink display
for what you do.
index.text.013: Adjust text contrast, shadow detail, and color on the e‑ink displays you choose. Your other displays stay unchanged.
index.aria-label.018: E-Ink Assistant application shown on a display
index.alt.019: E-Ink Assistant main controls in English
index.text.022: TEXT CONTRAST ✦ SHADOW DETAIL ✦ SATURATION + RGB ✦ PER-DISPLAY PRESETS ✦ TEXT CONTRAST ✦ SHADOW DETAIL ✦ SATURATION + RGB ✦ PER-DISPLAY PRESETS ✦
index.text.025: Text Contrast darkens reading pages. Video Enhance reveals dark image detail. Saturation and RGB help color e‑ink panels.
index.alt.026: Illustrative before and after reading-page contrast
index.text.028: Darkens faint body and secondary text for reading.
index.alt.029: Illustrative before and after shadow-detail landscape
index.text.031: Lifts dark photo and video tones to reveal shadow detail.
index.alt.032: Illustrative before and after color e-ink botanical still life
index.text.034: Compensate for muted color with Saturation and RGB.
index.text.035: Illustrative previews. Results vary by panel and source material.
index.text.040: The app uses the public display controls available on each operating system. Unsupported controls are hidden or explained.
index.text.042: Text Contrast, Video Enhance, curves, presets, and per-display settings.
index.text.044: Reduce Shaking and per-display Night Shift / True Tone handling.
index.text.046: Applicable Windows 10 2004 and Windows 11 21H2+ systems; availability depends on the system and hardware.
index.text.049: Text Contrast offers four levels for low-contrast pages.
index.text.050: Use it for reading; it is separate from Video Enhance.
index.text.053: Video Enhance lifts shadow detail in photos and video.
index.text.054: Turn it off for reading because it also lightens dark text.
index.text.057: Use presets or direct controls to compensate for a limited color gamut.
index.text.058: Availability depends on the operating system, GPU, driver, and display path.
index.text.061: Mark only the e‑ink displays you want the app to change.
index.text.062: Save curves for different displays and restore settings when the app exits.
index.alt.063: E-Ink Assistant advanced tone curve controls in English
index.text.065:
Adjust the curve
when presets are not enough.
index.text.066: Change knee, gamma, black point, and white point while viewing the curve.
index.text.067: Save up to five named presets. Settings are stored separately for each display.
index.aria-label.069: Scrollable macOS and Windows feature comparison
index.text.082: Four levels: Medium, Strong, Sharp, Solid
index.text.085: Live curve editor and five named presets
index.text.087: Per-display color profile; 0%–300% saturation and 0%–200% RGB
index.text.088: Available on applicable Windows 10 2004 and Windows 11 21H2+ systems; the available method depends on the system and hardware
index.text.090: Available on supported external displays; turns on when a display is marked as e‑ink
index.text.091: Not available. Windows has no unified public per-display dithering control, and most Windows systems probably do not need it.
index.text.093: Available through a one-time, user-confirmed helper

index.text.097: Session-only Windows Light Mode on Windows 10 1903+
index.text.099: Per-display Night Shift and True Tone exclusion; requires administrator approval and reconnect
index.text.100: Night Light settings from Windows 10 1703+; direct Disable Night Light control on Windows 11 24H2+
index.text.102: Mirrored physical displays remain individually selectable
index.text.103: Tone curves affect the shared source; Saturation and RGB require Extend mode
index.text.105: Temporary curves, color profiles, and dithering restore on quit; the Night Shift / True Tone exclusion is persistent
index.text.106: Temporary gamma, color, visual, and Night Light changes restore on quit; color and Night Light also recover after an abnormal exit

changelog.description.138: Release history for the macOS and Windows editions of E-Ink Assistant.
changelog.text.146: Hardware-mirrored secondary displays remain individually selectable and are tuned by physical output.
changelog.text.147: Switching between mirrored and extended layouts promptly refreshes and reapplies display settings.
changelog.text.148: Reapply and quit cleanup touch only marked e-ink panels while also covering online mirrored displays.
changelog.text.149: The setup tip now explicitly directs users to the monitor's own menu.
changelog.text.152: A dismissible reminder now appears above the controls, with a Bigme B251 Pro example.
changelog.text.153: Got it hides the reminder for the session; Never show it again persists after relaunch.
changelog.text.154: The welcome panel now uses three concise, icon-led setup points.
changelog.text.155: Built-in displays now appear after external displays in the selection list.
changelog.text.158: Panel height follows the current screen.
changelog.text.159: The control panel now uses the visible height of the screen containing the menu-bar item.
changelog.text.160: Tall content scrolls and leaves 40 points above the Dock or screen edge. Shorter panels keep their natural height.
changelog.text.162: Changed the Text Contrast preset values.
changelog.text.163: Medium uses the previous Strong curve. Strong, Sharp, and Solid are progressively darker.
changelog.text.164: Sharp uses gamma 5.00 with a 0.10 black point. Solid uses gamma 6.00 with a 0.34 black point. Both remove more gray detail and produce harder edges.
changelog.text.167: Fixed language switching in How this works.
changelog.text.168: The section heading and Show more / Show less button now update immediately when the app language changes.
changelog.text.171: The helper can run while the Mac is locked, preventing Shortcuts warnings during disconnect and cleanup.
changelog.text.172: Users upgrading from v2.0 must add the renamed helper once, then may remove the old helper.
changelog.text.175: Added display controls, languages, and a DMG installer.
changelog.text.176: Added per-display RGB, Night Shift, and True Tone controls.
changelog.text.177: Added Reduce Transparency and Motion control through a user-confirmed Shortcuts helper.
changelog.text.178: Added English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, and Japanese.
changelog.text.180: Added per-display Night Shift and True Tone control.
changelog.text.181: The change requires an administrator password and a display reconnect. It is not undone when the app quits.
changelog.text.184: Added Reduce Shaking, Saturation, Text Contrast, Video Enhance, custom tone curves, saved curve slots, and display restoration on quit.
changelog.text.188: Fixed false feature-failure warnings when Windows exposes a color pipeline but does not allow the app to change its state.
changelog.text.189: Recovery data is retained while Duplicate mode temporarily disables color control, then restored when a controllable display layout returns.
changelog.text.191: Added per-display Text Contrast, Video Enhance, advanced curves, presets, and e-ink display selection.
changelog.text.192: Added compatible Saturation, RGB, Windows Light Mode, and Night Light controls with restoration and crash recovery.
changelog.text.193: Added duplicate-display handling, system-tray onboarding, launch at login, updates, and a multilingual installer.
